name: cerno-prefill-sweep
command: for b in 64 32 16 8 4; do echo "== b=$b"; ./engine/pinfer_run_cerno2 -m models/cerno-4b-q4_0.pq -t 4 -b $b --ids-file tmp/cerno/ids/p64.ids -n 2 --bench 2>&1 | grep -E 'RESULT|prefill'; done; echo '== kv fp16 b=64'; ./engine/pinfer_run_cerno2 -m models/cerno-4b-q4_0.pq -t 4 --kv-dtype 1 --ids-file tmp/cerno/ids/p64.ids -n 2 --bench 2>&1 | grep -E 'RESULT|prefill'; echo '== p256 b=64'; ./engine/pinfer_run_cerno2 -m models/cerno-4b-q4_0.pq -t 4 --ids-file tmp/cerno/ids/p256.ids -n 2 --bench 2>&1 | grep -E 'RESULT|prefill'
